extraction_notes: The device is a PNP dual transistor. Electrical table signs are preserved as published, including negative IC, IB, VCE and saturation voltages.
Figure 13 is a usable log-log DC current gain plot. Points are direct readings from the TJ = 25 degC trace at visible axis positions; no interpolation was used.

The table also publishes V(BR)CBO = -40 V at IC = -10 uA, IE = 0; V(BR)EBO = -5.0 V at IE = -10 uA, IC = 0; continuous IC = -200 mA; PD = 150 mW at TA = 25 degC; these fields are not available in the strict extraction schema.

The table publishes both minimum and maximum hFE only at IC = -10 mA, and both minimum and maximum VBE(sat) at IC = -10 mA, so those bounds are represented as duplicate points with their source_kind preserved.
The datasheet gives no Early-voltage value or output-characteristics plot suitable for VAF extraction.
